name: @breadcrumb/demo-seed
description: A realistic learner's history, written straight into the database: 24 knowledge nodes across two domains with FSRS-verified sighting histories, the conversations they came from, mastery claims and vocabulary. Used by the guided tour so a newcomer sees the app doing its job instead of an empty map, and by the dev seeding CLI. Its integration test lives in packages/simlab, which owns the real-SQLite harness it needs.
